rows.en: Defeat all Shocker Combatants!
Defeat Executive Monster Spider Man and all Shocker Combatants!
All enemies destroyed
All allies are destroyed
All allies destroyed

Someone has infiltrated the base. Our communications equipment and the generator have been knocked out!

According to reports… there are only three intruders.

That's absurd!? …In any case, the operation is suspended!

Combatants, eliminate those intruders at once!!
It's around here, [HERO2]. This is where I lost my brother's presence…
Satoru… We're finally, finally going to see him!

This'll clear up what happened back then, right?

Wait a sec, [HERO2]. I'll pinpoint where my brother is with my "black magic"…

Hey… hold it! Quit it with your black magic hobby at a time like this. You know how much grief that stuff's put me through…

Just behave and use your usual "power." That's more reliable.

[HERO2], you meanie! My black magic's gotten a little better too, you know! So there!

Besides, my usual "power" is like ESP. It's unscientific.
Black magic's pretty much the same thing, isn't it? Quit complaining and just do it already.
Jeez, fine… Okay, here goes… wait…
Huh? What's this feeling?

…!?

[HERO4]… Get behind me!
Ah… [HERO2], you're bleeding.

Huh? When did they get me?

Damn… I've still got a long way to go.
That's not true. Your ancient martial arts have Grandpa's seal of approval, [HERO2]!
Seijiro, huh… [HERO4], you're not starting to want to go home, are you?

Nuh-uh…

I'm not giving up until I find my brother and find out what happened back then.

Right…

But just because you "sense" him, that's no guarantee Satoru's alive, you know?

He's alive…

I just know it! Besides, they didn't find him in the burned ruins either…

There… Your wound's all better now. I healed it with my "power"…
Thanks… That's your other "power," isn't it?
It seems we're one step too late…

Either way… whoever was here isn't the owner of the "scent of the beast," are they?

I'm sure they're somewhere around here, though…
Th-there they are! Get them!
Hmph… No point sticking around… We're pulling out! Follow the scent of the beast!
…[HERO2], did you hear that?
So he's had his body modified, the same as us…?
We have to help him…
But what about Satoru?
Looks like we were a little too late. My brother's presence is gone. More importantly…
Right… Now's the time to unleash my "power"!
[HERO4], we're helping him!
Okay!
All right, let's go!
We can talk later… We're not your enemies! For now, let's take care of these guys!

Are you the one modifying innocent people however you please?

I won't forgive anyone who does that! Treating people like mere tools… I will never allow that!

Are you the one modifying innocent people however you please?

I won't forgive anyone who does that! Treating people like mere tools… I will never allow that!
Is this a secret base? But it doesn't look like anyone's here… It's totally empty.
So this is their base? Satoru and the others… Could they be here?

…!?

I can sense my brother's presence. He must be close by.

…!?

Wh-wh-whoa… Wh-what? What's happening?
It's a self-destruct device! They're going to blow up this base!
[HERO4]! We're getting out of here!
W-w-wait a minute! [HERO2]!! Hey, [HERO2]!

Looks like it…

But… you looked really cool fighting. I'm glad you're not a bad guy.

A cyborg…?

Unfortunately, we're not, but… well, in the sense of being modified, maybe we're the same as you.
Who in the world are you two…?
Ordinary high school students… is what I'd like to say, but lately I've been on leave from school the whole time…
I'm [HERO2] Kanou.

I'm [HERO4] Hinata. [HERO2] and I are childhood friends.

Mr. Hongo… why did they do cyborg surgery on you? What kind of organization is Shocker?
That's horrible… So they turned you into a cyborg against your will?
But I… I get a really bad "feeling" about this somehow… a really strong one…

[HERO4] can sense the power around her. That's her ability…

Anyway… I'll never forgive anyone who modifies people in a way that ignores the human heart!

Yes… you're right.

It seems you two have your own circumstances…

But… I won't ask who you are anymore.

You fought alongside me… That's enough for me!

I've found allies I can count on in the fight against them… For me, no longer human, that's my one and only consolation.
…Mr. Hongo.
And so… the presence of Vortex, comrades whose plight resembled his own, made Hongo resolve to use his own power to challenge Shocker.
[HERO2]… What do you two plan to do now?

Let's see… Above all, we need information.

About Shocker, of course, but we also don't know much about how things stand on Earth right now…

So we need a place where we can gather all sorts of information.

I see…

Shocker aside, if it's the state of the world you want, I know a good place.

It's a snack bar run by the trainer of the racing team I belong to. A man named Tobei Tachibana. I'm sure he'll help us out.
[HERO2]… What do you two plan to do now?
Even if you ask what we'll do… we're drifters, so…
Drifters?
Our house burned down in a big fire, so…

I see… In that case, I know a good place.

It's a snack bar run by the trainer of the racing team I belong to. A man named Tobei Tachibana. I'm sure he'll help us out.
Oyassan… Oyassan Tachibana!

…!?

Takeshi!! It's you, Takeshi!

Where on earth have you been this past week? You vanished right in the middle of a practice run… I searched all over for you.
I'm sorry I worried you. The truth is…

Hmm, it's a hard story to believe…

So that's where you get strength more than ten times a normal human's?

Yes…

Wind pressure turns the dynamo, the energy builds up, and that energy flows into my modified muscles! I still can't believe it myself.

But… this is reality!

I've decided… I'll use this power to crush Shocker's schemes!

Mm… Now that's the Takeshi Hongo I know!

Besides, you always had reflexes and stamina way beyond the average person. Now that's been artificially modified on top of it… you've got a body with limits nobody can measure!

With training… that power will grow even more! I'll lend a hand too, for what it's worth.
Thanks, Oyassan!
Mr. Tachibana, thank you so much for having us.
Oh, come now… Being thanked by such a pretty young lady makes me downright bashful.

[HERO4]… Let's start getting ready to gather information right away.

Is there anything like a computer in this shop?

A computer?

Oh… There's an old one in the back that I use for the shop's accounts.

uncertain: U00245-U00247: read as victory/defeat labels with glyph noise (奴の姉息=敵の全滅, 駄味が姉息させられたとき=味方が全滅させられたとき, 駄味の姉息=味方の全滅)
U00244: 幹部怪人 rendered 'Executive Monster' (glossary uses Monster for 怪人)
U00269: owner of the 'scent of the beast' is unidentified; kept gender-neutral 'they'
U00273: what she heard is not shown (probably Hongo); kept 'did you hear that?'
U00292: answers a line not in this batch (likely Hongo saying he was turned into a cyborg)
U00303: narration row begins mid-text (leading space); treated as a standalone sentence
U00312: 立花のおやっさん rendered 'Oyassan Tachibana'
U00319: よろしくお願いします from heroine to Tachibana rendered as thanks, since he replies about being thanked

new_names.why: speaker_en null on hero/heroine dialogue rows
surname hard-coded in JP; spelling from glossary 叶エイジ = Eiji Kanou
